variants.name: Скулолом
variants.description: Develop THIS same Kostyash hobgoblin into a close design variant, not a different species or character. Preserve his compact135px native figure height, hunched lean but stocky body, oversized angular skull-like living face, heavy brow, protruding jaw, short bent legs, broad bony hands and clawed feet. Keep front3/4 view facing left, same pose and same position on a256x256 transparent canvas. Keep cool pale gray-blue sick skin, tattered near-black loincloth, one battered rust-brown round shoulder guard on image-right, and short dark iron mace held forward on image-left. Less human, slightly feral, with crooked ears and small fangs, not a human skeleton or zombie. Retain a few large yellow-pink skin blisters; no gore. Clean readable pixel clusters, dark local outlines, simple2-3tone planes like a compact fantasy tactical-game sprite. Reduce isolated noisy speckles without making the pixel grid coarser. No extra fine texture. Entire crown, ears, fingers, weapon and toes must be complete, with wide empty margins. Do not enlarge, stretch, crop or add background/shadow/base. Change only the focused design accents below; keep Kostyash recognizable. Make his facial structure more distinctive: a broad irregular bony brow ridge, blunt asymmetrical cheekbones and a wide low jaw. Add two blunt bone-hard knuckles, not long horns. Keep the skin over the bones and the original shoulder guard and mace. Face must remain expressive and readable with just a few large planes.
